description: Crypto wallet sanctions screening: check whether a blockchain address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron and more) appears on sanctions lists such as OFAC SDN. Use before sending funds, accepting a payment or onboarding a counterparty to answer: is this wallet address sanctioned? Fast boolean verdict with list match details. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

address.description: Wallet address to screen. EVM addresses (0x + 40 hex) get full on-chain signals; any chain's address format is checked against the sanctions lists.

name: agentbit.wallet_screen
title: Wallet Screening
